sources.title: ibm-granite/granite-3.2-2b-instruct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Summary: Granite-3.2-2B-Instruct is an 2-billion-parameter, long-context AI model fine-tuned for thinking capabilities. Built on top of Granite-3.1-2B-Instruct, it has been trained using a mix of permissively licensed open-source datasets and internally generated synthetic data designed for reasoning tasks.
